```{r set up}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(urbnthemes)
library(urbnmapr)
set_urbn_defaults(style = "map")
library(ggspatial)
library(ggstar)
```
```

```{r define colors}
rfk_west_color <- "#ec008b"
rfk_east_color <- "#55b748"
metro_sta_color <- "#db2b27"
rfk_stadium_star_color <- "#fdbf11"
rfk_stadium_star_color2 <- "#db2b27"
```


```{r load data}
rfk_tracts <- read.csv("//sas1/dcdata/Libraries/Requests/Prog/2026/RFK/Result/rfk_tracts.csv")
 rfk_tracts$GEOID <- as.character(rfk_tracts$GEOID)

cat_order <- c("Highest", "Higher", "Intermediate", "Lower", "Lowest")

displacement_risk <- read.xlsx("//sas1/dcdata/Libraries/Requests/Prog/2026/RFK/Data/Displacement Risk and Neighborhood Change.xlsx") %>%
  mutate(
    GEOID = as.character(GEOID),
    across(
      c(population_vulnerability_cat, housing_condition_cat, market_pressure_cat, displacement_cat), ~ordered(.x, levels = cat_order)))

tracts <- st_read("//sas1/dcdata/Libraries/Requests/Prog/2026/RFK/Data/Census_Tracts_in_2020/Census_Tracts_in_2020.shp")

rfk_tracts_shape <- tracts %>%
  left_join(rfk_tracts, by = "GEOID")

displacement_risk_shape <- tracts %>%
  left_join( displacement_risk, by = "GEOID") %>%
  mutate(
    neighborhoodtype = recode(
      neighborhoodtype,
      "Exclusion of Households with Low Income" = "Exclusion of HHs with Low Incomes",
      "Gain of Households with Low Income" = "Gain of HHs with Low Incomes",
      "Loss of Households with Low Income" = "Loss of HHs with Low Incomes",
      "no change" = "No Change")
  )
  

displacement_risk_rfk <- displacement_risk %>%
  left_join(rfk_tracts, by = "GEOID") %>%
  mutate(ward7 = if_else(Ward == "Ward 7", 1, 0))
```

```{r map prep}

wards <- st_read("//sas1/dcdata/Libraries/Requests/Prog/2026/RFK/Data/Ward_-_2022/Ward_-_2022.shp")

dc <- wards %>%
  st_combine()

anc <- st_read("//sas1/dcdata/Libraries/OCTO/Maps/Advisory_Neighborhood_Commissions_from_2023.shp")

roads <- st_read("//sas1/dcdata/Libraries/Requests/Prog/2026/RFK/Data/Roads/Roads.shp")

water <- st_read("//sas1/dcdata/Libraries/Requests/Prog/2026/RFK/Data/Waterbodies_2023/Waterbodies_2023.shp") %>%
  mutate(water = "Waterways")

metro <- st_read("//sas1/dcdata/Libraries/Requests/Prog/2026/RFK/Data/Metro_Stations_Regional/Metro_Stations_Regional.shp") %>%
  mutate(line1 = case_when(LINE == "blue, yellow"~ "yellow",
                           LINE == "blue, orange, silver"~ "blue",
                           LINE == "blue, silver"~ "blue",
                           LINE == "green, yellow, orange, blue, silver"~ "green",
                           LINE == "green, yellow"~ "green",
                           LINE == "red, green, yellow" ~ "green",
                           LINE == "red, blue, orange, silver"~ "red", 
                           LINE == "red, green" ~ "green", 
                           LINE == "orange, silver" ~ "orange"
                           ),
         line_name = if_else(is.na(line1), LINE, line1), 
         line_color = if_else(line_name == "silver", "grey", line_name))
dc_metro <- metro %>%
  st_filter(., dc, .predicate = st_intersects)

bus <- st_read("//sas1/dcdata/Libraries/Requests/Prog/2026/RFK/Data/Metro_Bus_Stops_2023_-_2025/Metro_Bus_Stops_2023_-_2025.shp")

national_parks <- st_read("//sas1/dcdata/Libraries/Requests/Prog/2026/RFK/Data/National_Parks/National_Parks.shp") %>%
  mutate(parks = "National Parks")

build_permits <- st_read("//sas1/dcdata/Libraries/Requests/Prog/2026/RFK/Data/Building_Permits_in_2025/Building_Permits_in_2025.shp")
rfk_permit <- build_permits %>%
  filter(OBJECTID == 1097829048) %>%
  #filter(FULL_ADDRE == "2400 EAST CAPITOL ST SE, WASHINGTON, DC 20003") %>%
  mutate(label = "RFK Stadium")

#create dataframe with stadium coordinates
#stadium_coord <- data.frame(lon = -76.9718667, lat = 38.8898532)

#convert to sf object and set coordinate system reference
stadium_sf <- st_as_sf(data.frame(lon = -76.9718667, lat = 38.8898532), coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)

ward7 <- wards %>%
  filter(WARD_ID == "7")

ward6 <- wards %>%
  filter(WARD_ID == "6")

#Find ward 7 coordinates, for zooming in on area
ward7coords = as.data.frame(unique(st_coordinates(ward7)))

#find x where y is max in ward 6 for x minimum
ward6coords = as.data.frame(unique(st_coordinates(ward6))) %>%
  filter(Y == max(Y))


#minimmum of Y
ymin = min(ward7coords$Y)
ymax = max(ward7coords$Y)
xmin = ward6coords$X
xmax = max(ward7coords$X)

#DC Coordinates
dccoords = as.data.frame(unique(st_coordinates(wards)))

dcymin = min(dccoords$Y)
dcymax = max(dccoords$Y)
dcxmin = min(dccoords$X)
dcxmax = max(dccoords$X)

#for outlines of the RFK areas
west_outline <- rfk_tracts_shape %>%
  filter(west_of_anacostia == 1)

east_outline <- rfk_tracts_shape %>%
  filter(east_of_anacostia == 1)

outlines <- ggplot()+
  geom_sf(data = west_outline, aes(geometry = geometry, color = rfk_sub_group), fill = NA) +
  geom_sf(data = east_outline, aes(geometry = geometry, color = rfk_sub_group), fill = NA) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(rfk_east_color, rfk_west_color), name = NULL)
outlines
```

displacement <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = displacement_risk_shape, aes(geometry = geometry, fill = factor(displacement_cat, levels = cat_order)), color = NA) +
   scale_fill_manual(name = "Displacement Risk", values = c("#062635","#12719E","#1696D2","#73BFE2","#CFE8F3")) +
  #display a star at stadium coordinates
  geom_sf(data = stadium_sf, aes( geometry = geometry, color = "RFK Stadium" ), shape = "\u2605", size = 5) +
  #Metro stations
  geom_sf(data = dc_metro, aes( geometry = geometry, color = "Metrorail Stations" ), shape = 15, size = 1.5) +
  geom_sf(data = west_outline, aes(color = rfk_sub_group), fill = NA) +
  geom_sf(data = east_outline, aes(color = rfk_sub_group), fill = NA) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "RFK East" = rfk_east_color,
      "RFK West" = rfk_west_color,
      "RFK Stadium" = rfk_stadium_star_color,
      "Metrorail Stations" = metro_sta_color
    ),
    limits = c(
    "RFK East",
    "RFK West",
    "RFK Stadium",
    "Metrorail Stations"
  ),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(order = 1),
    color = guide_legend(order = 2)
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.spacing.y = unit(0.05, "cm"),
    legend.position = c(1.3, 0.0),
    legend.justification = c("right", "bottom")
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(dcxmin, dcxmax),
    ylim = c(dcymin, dcymax),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  annotation_scale(unit_category = "imperial")

displacement

ggsave(filename = "//sas1/dcdata/Libraries/Requests/Prog/2026/RFK/Result/displacement vulnerability/map displacement.png",
       plot = displacement,
       device = "png",
       width = 6.5,
       dpi = 1000)

neighborhood_type <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = displacement_risk_shape, aes(geometry = geometry, fill = neighborhoodtype), color = NA) +

    na.value = "#d2d2d2") +

```{r tables}
wb <- createWorkbook()

tab_population_vulnerability <- displacement_risk_rfk %>%
  group_by(population_vulnerability_cat) %>%
  summarise(DC = n(),
            ward7 = sum(ward7), 
            RFK = sum(rfk_group), 
            east_of_anacostia = sum(east_of_anacostia), 
            west_of_anacostia = sum(west_of_anacostia))
addWorksheet(wb, "population_vulnerability")
writeData(wb, "population_vulnerability", tab_population_vulnerability)

tab_housing_condition <- displacement_risk_rfk %>%
  group_by(housing_condition_cat) %>%
  summarise(DC = n(),
            ward7 = sum(ward7), 
            RFK = sum(rfk_group), 
            east_of_anacostia = sum(east_of_anacostia), 
            west_of_anacostia = sum(west_of_anacostia))
addWorksheet(wb, "housing_condition")
writeData(wb, "housing_condition", tab_housing_condition)

tab_market_pressure <- displacement_risk_rfk %>%
  group_by(market_pressure_cat) %>%
  summarise(DC = n(),
            ward7 = sum(ward7), 
            RFK = sum(rfk_group), 
            east_of_anacostia = sum(east_of_anacostia), 
            west_of_anacostia = sum(west_of_anacostia))
addWorksheet(wb, "market_pressure")
writeData(wb, "market_pressure", tab_market_pressure)

tab_displacement <- displacement_risk_rfk %>%
  group_by(displacement_cat) %>%
  summarise(DC = n(),
            ward7 = sum(ward7), 
            RFK = sum(rfk_group), 
            east_of_anacostia = sum(east_of_anacostia), 
            west_of_anacostia = sum(west_of_anacostia))
addWorksheet(wb, "displacement")
writeData(wb, "displacement", tab_displacement)

tab_neighborhood_type <- displacement_risk_rfk %>%
  group_by(neighborhoodtype) %>%
  summarise(DC = n(),
            ward7 = sum(ward7), 
            RFK = sum(rfk_group), 
            east_of_anacostia = sum(east_of_anacostia), 
            west_of_anacostia = sum(west_of_anacostia))
addWorksheet(wb, "neighborhood_type")
writeData(wb, "neighborhood_type", tab_neighborhood_type)

saveWorkbook(wb, "//sas1/dcdata/Libraries/Requests/Prog/2026/RFK/Result/displacement vulnerability/tables.xlsx")
